help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  While slotted this enhancement has a chance every 5 seconds to give you an absorption barrier.  If your health is between 31% and 75%, this power has a 10% chance of triggering.  However, if your health is less than 31% there is a 100% chance of it triggering.  This effect can only trigger once every 120 seconds.
